title: Ireland – Repair and maintenance services of mechanical building installations – Fabrication and maintenance 2026
description: Dublin Bus is looking to establish a fabrication and maintenance framework with appropriate Contractors to carry out repair and maintenance at each of its facilities which consists of All locations throughout Dublin City and County. title: Germany – Heating, ventilation and air-conditioning installation work – Anlagenbau Kompressionswärmepumpe
description: Der Auftraggeber erweitert seine Heizzentrale am Hartmut-Hermann-Weg 4 in 85716 Unterschleißheim. In der bestehenden Heizzentrale sind drei fossile Feuerungsanlagen mit einer Feuerungsleistung von jeweils unter 10 MW sowie drei Geothermie-Wärmetauscher vorhanden. Die Erweiterung ist mit vier Kompressionswärmepumpen mit einer Gesamtheizleistung von 10 MW und einer fossilen Feuerungsanlage mit unter 10 MW geplant. Folgende weitere Großkomponenten sind zu installieren: • Schallschutzkapsel zur Integration der Wärmepumpen in die Heizzentrale • Integration des bestehenden Heizkessels in Containerausführung in die Heizzentrale • Erneuerung der drei bestehenden Geothermiewärmetauscher • Erneuerung der Druckhaltung des Fernwärmenetzes • Erneuerung des Ölförderaggregats In der Heizungstechnik sind Rohrleitungen mit Formstücken aus geschweißtem Stahlrohr PN 16 sowie Pumpen und Armaturen bis zu einer Dimension von DN 300, Abgasleitungen aus Edelstahl bis zu einer Dimension von DN 800, Gasleitungen aus geschweißtem Stahlrohr bis zu einer Dimension von DN 150 und Ölleitungen aus geschweißtem Stahlrohr bis zu einer Dimension von DN 50 zu installieren. Die wärmeführenden Leitungen sind mittels Mineralfaserdämmung mit Blechmantel zu isolieren. In der Kältetechnik sind Kältemittelleitungen sowie Außen- und Inneneinheiten mit einer Gesamtleistung von ca. 100 kW zu installieren. In der Lüftungstechnik sind Wetterschutzgitter zur Verbrennungsluftnachströmung sowie Entwärmungs- und Belüftungsventilatoren mit einer maximalen Luftmenge von 20.000 m³/h zu installieren. Elektrotechnisch ist eine neue Trafoanlage (2.000 kVA) mit entsprechenden Installationen zu den Hauptabnehmern, den Kompressionswärmepumpen, und mit Kabeln bis 300 mm² vorgesehen. Ebenso ist eine Mittelspannungsanlage zu installieren. Weitere Niederspannungsabnehmer, wie vor allem heizungs- und kältetechnische Verbraucher, sind über eine Niederspannungshauptversorgung zu versorgen. Regelungstechnisch ist die bestehende Leitstation zu erweitern, Komponenten sind zu integrieren sowie neue regelungstechnische Anlagen aufzubauen.

description: Opdrachtgever heeft als doel om op basis van deze Europese openbare aanbestedingsprocedure volgens de Aanbestedingswet 2012 te komen tot een raamovereenkomst met 3 (drie) Opdrachtnemers, waarbij de afdeling Communicatie en Kabinetszaken, van Opdrachtgever, haar afzonderlijke (deel)opdrachten aan de gecontracteerde Opdrachtnemers kan verstrekken zonder daar afzonderlijke aanbestedingsprocedures voor te moeten doorlopen. Deze opdracht bestaat uit het leveren van inhuur professionals Communicatie & Kabinetszaken en betreft een raamovereenkomst met een geraamde waarde van €2.140.000,-. Het genoemde bedrag is een indicatie, derhalve kan aan het genoemde bedrag geen rechten ontleend worden. De opdrachtwaarde over de totale looptijd van de raamovereenkomst wordt gemaximeerd op 150% van het bedrag zoals hierboven vermeld bij ‘Omvang opdracht’. Dit leidt tot een maximale opdrachtwaarde excl. btw van deze aanbesteding van €3.210.000,-. Als deze waarde bereikt is mag er alleen nog volgens de bepalingen van de artikelen 2.163a t/m 2.163g van de Aanbestedingswet 2012 gebruik gemaakt worden van de raamovereenkomst. Als op deze bepalingen geen beroep meer kan worden gedaan, sorteert de raamovereenkomst geen effect meer en mag er door de gemeente geen gebruik meer van worden gemaakt, ongeacht de dan nog resterende looptijd van de raamovereenkomst. De raamovereenkomst zal in dat geval – als de maximale waarde is bereikt of deze zeer binnenkort zal worden overschreden - door de gemeente met de Opdrachtnemer worden opgezegd met een opzeggingstermijn van één maand. Door deze opzegging ontstaat geen recht op schadevergoeding van de gemeente aan de Opdrachtnemer.

title: Hungary – Pipeline, piping, pipes, casing, tubing and related items – K26123 Fémcsövek, idomok, karimák beszerzése
description: Dinamikus beszerzési rendszer létrehozása „K26123 Fémcsövek, idomok és karimák beszerzése közszolgáltatáshoz” tárgyban 36 hónap időtartamra, tervezetten nettó 190 000 000, HUF keretösszeg erejéig. A dinamikus beszerzési rendszer keretében különböző típusú és méretű fémcsövek és hozzá tartozó idomok, illetve karimák szállítása és adásvétele kerül megvalósításra. Ajánlatkérő távhőszolgáltatási területén üzemelő, közszolgáltatást ellátó távhőtechnológiai létesítményeinek felújítási és karbantartási munkái során különböző típusú és méretű fémcsövek és hozzá tartozó idomok, illetve karimák kerülnek felhasználásra. A fémcsöveket és idomokat, valamint karimákat az alábbi termék kategóriákban kívánjuk beszerezni: 1. kategória: Hegeszthető acélcsövek Jellemzően, de nem kizárólagosan EN 10216-2 szabvány szerinti varrat nélküli acélcső, EN 10217-2 szabvány szerinti hosszvarratos vagy spirálvarratos acélcső, EN 10217-5 szabvány szerinti, spirálvarrattal hegesztett acélcső. 2. kategória: Hegeszthető acél idomok Jellemzően, de nem kizárólagosan: könyök idom (forrcsőív), T-idom, koncentrikus szűkítő idom, excentrikus szűkítő idom, mélydomború edényfenék, hegeszthető fekete karmantyú. 3. kategória: Karimák Jellemzően, de nem kizárólagosan: hegtoldatos karima PN 6, DIN 2631 és MSZ EN 1092-1 szabvány szerint; hegtoldatos karima PN 16, DIN 2633 és MSZ EN 1092-1 szabvány szerint; hegtoldatos karima PN 25, DIN 2634 és MSZ EN 1092-1 szabvány szerint; hegtoldatos karima PN 40, DIN 2635 és MSZ EN 1092-1 szabvány szerint; vakkarima PN16, PN25, PN40 nyomásfokozatban, MSZ EN 1092-1 szabvány szerint; horganyzott menetes karima PN 10-16, MSZ EN 1092-1 szabvány szerint. 4. kategória: Menetes idomok Jellemzően, de nem kizárólagosan: horganyzott menetes idomok, sárgaréz és/vagy vörös öntvény idomok MSZ EN ISO 228-1 szabvány szerinti menet kialakításban, rozsdamentes acél menetes idomok. Ajánlatkérőnél az üzemeltetés során felmerülő, konkrét igénye alapján, tervezetten kategóriánként a mennyiség a teljes időszakra vonatkozóan (36 hónap): 1. kategória: Hegeszthető acélcsövek 83 490 kg. 2. kategória: Hegeszthető acél idomok 29 272 db. 3. kategória: Karimák 8 154 db. 4. kategória: Menetes idomok 28 513 db. A megadott mennyiség a korábbi felhasználási tapasztalatok alapján került meghatározásra, ún. tapasztalati mennyiség, a beszerzett mennyiség ezen tapasztalati adattól eltérhet. DBR keretében odaítélendő egyes szerződések várható maximális mennyisége: 1. kategória: Hegeszthető acélcsövek 11 000 kg. 2. kategória: Hegeszthető acél idomok 3 500 db. 3. kategória: Karimák 820 db. 4. kategória: Menetes idomok 3 020 db. A DBR-ben megvalósítandó konkrét közbeszerzésre vonatkozó pontos, részletes műszaki leírást és szerződésestervezetet ajánlatkérő az ajánlattételi felhívás megküldésével egyidejűleg bocsátja rendelkezésre. Ajánlatkérő az eljárás jelen szakaszában a beszerzendő termékek általános műszaki elvárásait tartalmazó műszaki leírást és szerződéses feltételeket bocsátja a részvételre jelentkezők számára, amelyek az egyes termékkategóriák vonatkozásában tartalmazzák az általános elvárásokat. Ajánlatkérő fenntartja annak a lehetőségét, hogy a beszerzendő termékek beazonosítása, valamint a termékekkel szemben támasztott műszaki elvárások teljesíthetősége érdekében az ajánlattételi szakaszokban referencia termékeket nevezzen meg. Ajánlatkérő a Kbt. 107. § (2) bekezdése alapján fenntartja annak a lehetőségét, hogy a DBR-ben megvalósítandó konkrét közbeszerzések során - a konkrét közbeszerzések tárgyától és jellegétől függően - részajánlat-tételi lehetőséget határozzon meg az ajánlattételi felhívásban az abban foglalt konkrét beszerzési igényre vonatkozóan. Ajánlatkérő fenntartja a jogot, hogy a DBR-ben megvalósítandó konkrét közbeszerzés(ek) eredményeként akár egyedi adásvételi szerződést, akár egyedi adásvételi keretszerződést kössön. Ajánlatkérő amennyiben keretszerződést köt és keretösszeg kerül meghatározásra, úgy 70%-os ajánlatkérői lehívási kötelezettséggel, és emellett a szerződés tárgyát képező egyes termékek beszerzésimennyisége kizárólag tájékoztató jellegű becsült mennyiséggel, amelytől Ajánlatkérő jogosult eltérni. A 321/2015. (X. 30.) Korm. rendelet 46.§ (3) bekezdés: bármely meghatározott gyártmányú, eredetű, típusú dologra, eljárásra, tevékenységre, személyre, szabadalomra vagy védjegyre való hivatkozás, megnevezés csak a tárgy jellegének egyértelmű meghatározása érdekében történik, a megnevezés mellett a „vagy azzal egyenértékű” minden esetben értendő. Egyenértékű termék megajánlása esetén az egyenértékűséget ajánlattevőnek az ajánlatában igazolnia kell. III.4.1) Alkalmassági követelmény(ek)/Hivatkozások meghatározott szállításokra (BT-750 mező) szakasz folytatása: Ajánlatkérő a 321/2015. (X. 30.) Korm. rendelet 21/A. §-ában előírtakon túl további szerződésszegési köröket, amellyel érintett teljesítések igazolását elfogadja, nem ír elő. Ajánlatkérő a 321/2015. Korm. rendelet 21/A. § alapján elfogadja az alkalmasság alátámasztására azon referenciákat is, amelyek esetén bár szerződésszegés történt, de a gazdasági szereplő szerződésszegésért való felelőssége – a szerződést kötő másik fél által nem vitatottan – nem áll fenn. A Kbt. 65. § (6) bekezdése alapján a fenti követelményeknek a közös ajánlattevők együttesen is megfelelhetnek. A Kbt. 107. § (8a) bekezdése alapján amennyiben az alkalmassági követelmények tekintetében változás áll be a DBR-be felvett érvényes részvételi jelentkezést benyújtó gazdasági szereplő, annak kapacitást nyújtó szervezete vagy alvállalkozója esetében, azt a gazdasági szereplő köteles haladéktalanul jelezni Ajánlatkérőnek. A Kbt. 107. § (8b) bekezdése alapján azon részvételre jelentkezők esetében, akik jelentkezésüket a részvételi határidő lejártát követően nyújtják be, a jelen pontban rögzített időszak meghatározásához használt referenciaidőpont alatt a felhívás feladása helyett a részvételi jelentkezés benyújtása értendő.

Die Nachhaftung beträgt in der Haftpflichtversicherung 10 Jahre, in der Umwelthaftpflicht- und Umweltschadenversicherung 5 Jahre. Der generelle Selbstbehalt beträgt mindestens EUR 25.000. title: Ireland – Feasibility study, advisory service, analysis – Provision of Multidisciplinary Consultancy Services for the Development of the Tuam Creative Technologies Hub
description: Action Tuam CLG invites tenders from suitably qualified and experienced multidisciplinary consultancy teams for the provision of professional services to support the feasibility assessment, business planning and development of the proposed Tuam Creative Technologies Hub in Tuam, County Galway. The appointment will involve an integrated programme of consultancy services encompassing strategic and business case development, market and stakeholder engagement, academic and research opportunities, comparative site assessment, technical and infrastructure considerations, financial modelling, governance, funding strategy and project development planning. The successful consultant will be required to undertake a comparative desk-based assessment of three potential sites, followed by a more detailed evaluation of one site selected by Action Tuam. The assignment will also include stakeholder and community engagement, development of promotional and marketing materials, and preparation of the reports, recommendations and supporting evidence required to inform subsequent investment and implementation decisions. The project is supported through Enterprise Ireland's Smart Regions Enterprise Innovation Scheme, Stream 4 (Feasibility and Priming). The consultancy will be delivered on a fixed-fee basis, with defined deliverables, milestones and reporting requirements. Full details of the required services, deliverables, tender submission requirements and evaluation methodology are provided in the accompanying procurement documentation. All communications and requests for clarification concerning this competition must be submitted through the eTenders messaging facility.

title: Ireland – Engines – Supply of Engines and Sundry Engine Components
description: It is the intention of Dublin Bus to use a multi-provider framework agreement for a term of four years with the possibility of Dublin Bus extending that term by four periods of twelve months. Dublin Bus intends to establish a multi-provider framework panel of suppliers for the supply and delivery of Engines and Sundry Engine Components to its various locations throughout Dublin. This Framework will seek to cater for the supply of replacement engines for the legacy diesel fleet as required, as well as established maintenance spare parts and any new items in this category as they arise over the term of the arrangement. title: Ireland – Social research services – Evaluation of Ushers Island Health and Addiction Care Facility (HACF)
description: The HSE wishes to invite tenders from suitable suppliers to undertake an external evaluation of Ushers Island Health and Addiction Care Facility (HACF), operated by Dublin Simon and funded by HSE and Department of Health (DoH). Ushers Island delivers a suite of integrated, low threshold health, addiction and recovery services for people experiencing homelessness and severe social exclusion. The service model operates across a continuum that includes Blood Borne Virus (BBV) treatment, Detoxification, Step Up Step Down (SUSD) Medical care, Stabilisation, and Recovery Phase 1. Services are designed to respond flexibly to fluctuating clinical needs, support hospital avoidance, and discharge, and promote sustained engagement for individuals with complex physical health, mental health, substance use and social care needs.

title: Ireland – Laboratory, optical and precision equipments (excl. glasses) – LA3768C - Request-for-Tenders under Open (National) Procedure for the Supply, Delivery, Installation and Calibration of a Single Particle Fluorescence Sensor for Dublin City University (DCU)
description: Dublin City University requires the supply, delivery, installation, and commissioning of one (1) single-particle ultraviolet light-induced fluorescence aerosol monitor, for the measurement and characterisation of fine airborne particles. The system should be suitable for research applications involving biological and non-biological aerosol particles, with particular focus on the excitation and emission ranges relevant to biological particles. The proposed system must be capable of measuring individual airborne particles and providing information on their physical and fluorescence properties. The system must include all hardware, software, licenses, accessories, and components required for routine operation, data acquisition, data export, quality control, and analysis, unless clearly identified as optional items in the Appendix 2 Pricing Schedule.

title: 26055 Child Weight Management
description: Since 2023, there has been a standalone, integrated Child Weight Management Service in Cambridgeshire, commissioned by Public Health. title: Iceland – Project management consultancy services – Appointment of a Client Side Support Team for Göng og brú ohf.
description: Göng og brú ohf. is a State-owned public limited company established under the Infrastructure Company Act No. 70/2026. The company’s purpose is to deliver large transport infrastructure projects of national economic importance in Iceland and to secure their financing and faster delivery. Its role is to own, finance, build, maintain and operate the transport infrastructure it takes on, to collect road tolls, to ensure the financial sustainability of its projects, and to ensure professional preparation and risk management of its investment decisions. As its first major appointment, Göng og brú seeks to appoint a Client Side Support Team (CSST) to act as its client-side advisory partner across the full lifecycle of its programme, from early development and feasibility through construction, commissioning, maintenance and operations. The initial portfolio comprises Sundabraut, the Hvalfjarðargöng second bore and the Ölfusárbrú project, which involves a forward financing arrangement for a new bridge already under construction. Further projects may be added to the portfolio over time. The CSST will provide the breadth and depth of expertise required for Göng og brú to act as an informed and capable client, including support for the programme’s digital strategy and an understanding of Icelandic geological and geotechnical conditions. The CSST must maintain an exclusive client-side position, free from participation in the programme’s supply chain, during the contract term. Key personnel may be required to be based in Iceland. The contract has an initial term of five years, extendable by up to five further periods of three years each, giving a maximum total term of 20 years. The scope of services of the CSST includes, but is not limited to, design and planning support, programme and project management, procurement and contract management support, cost, schedule and risk management, technical oversight, and related commercial, financial, digital, environmental and safety advisory services. The full description of the indicative scope of services is set out in the “CSST Scope of Services” in Appendix D to the PIM document. Regarding the Programme: Candidates should note that it is not anticipated that the Consultant will have a significant role in Ölfusárbrú. The Purchaser may choose to include further projects in the Contract by giving written notice to the Consultant.

title: Wavebreak Construction And Delivery – Nova Scotia West
description: The work covered under this project consists of furnishing all plant, labour, equipment, and materials for construction and supply of timber floating wavebreaks for Nova Scotia West. The scope of work under this Contract includes, but not limited to: the construction and supply of eight (eight) timber floating wavebreaks in accordance with the accompanying drawings and specifications. Contract includes mobilization and demobilization of all equipment, labour, and materials necessary to complete the work. The successful contractor is responsible for environmental controls and Health & Safety controls in strict accordance with the specifications and accompanying drawings. Subject to the terms and conditions of this Contract. Only items in the Unit Price Table will be measured for payment. All other work necessary to complete the Contract will be considered incidental to the project and will not be measured separately for payment. Before submitting a bid, bidders can visit the site and its surroundings, at their own expense and schedule, to review and verify the form, nature, and extent of the work, materials needed for the completion of the work, the means of access to the site, site remoteness, severity, exposure, and uncertainty of weather, soil conditions, any accommodations they may require, and in general shall obtain all necessary information as to risks, contingencies, and other circumstances which may influence or affect their bid. No allowance shall be made subsequently in this connection on account or error or negligence to properly observe and determine the conditions that will apply. Take all appropriate safety measures for any visit to site, either before or after acceptance of bid. Work shall progress in a manner as to not impede the day to day fishing operations. All work under this Contract must be completed by March 31st, 2027.

title: F1701-261000 - National Individual Standing Offer (NISO) – Wireless Intercom System
description: Canada is seeking offers from Offerors to provide wireless internal communications systems for use onboard Canadian Coast Guard (CCG) vessels located across Canada. It is expected that PSPC will issue one Standing Offer as a result of this Request For Standing Offer. The standing offer will be available for use by CCG users across Canada. The standing offer will have a three-year term, with an option to extend for two additional one-year periods. The estimated usage of the standing offer is $850,000.00 per year but this is subject to change based upon CCG’s operational needs.

title: Správa webu mcvrk.mzk.cz
description: Předmětem zakázky je správa webového portálu mcvrk.mzk.cz, která konkrétně představuje: - Servisní podporu – udržování webového portálu v provozu. Zejména je třeba řešit chyby a výpadky tak, aby web byl provozuschopný, schopný plnit svůj účel a jeho zabezpečení odpovídalo obecně známému stavu technických znalostí a dále je třeba odstraňovat incidenty spojené s provozem webu. - Služby rozvoje webu – úprava stávajících funkcí webu, vytváření nových funkcionalit webu a vytváření jakýchkoli jiných změn nebo doplnění webu včetně udělení oprávnění k užití. Bližší informace v přiložené Výzvě k podání nabídky.

title: Oprava elektroinstalací – rámcová smlouva
description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky „Oprava elektroinstalací – rámcová smlouva“ je uzavření rámcové smlouvy o dílo na provádění průběžných oprav, úprav, dodávek a montáží elektroinstalací v objektech zadavatele podle jeho aktuálních provozních potřeb, a to s jedním dodavatelem. Podrobné požadavky zadavatele jsou uvedeny v přílohách výzvy k podání nabídek. Předmětem jsou zejména elektroinstalační, montážní, opravné a související stavebně-technické práce a související dodávky materiálu, měření, zkoušky a revize. Předpokládaná hodnota ve výši 4.000.000,- Kč bez DPH je maximální nepřekročitelnou hodnotou rámcové smlouvy. Jedná se o celkový maximální finanční limit rámcové smlouvy; zadavatel není povinen tento limit vyčerpat.

title: Lieferung und Installation von audiovisueller Medientechnik
description: Die Universität Tübingen errichtet am Standort Oberer Schnarrenberg einen Ersatzneubau für die Pathologie und Humangenetik (einschließlich mikrobiologischer Diagnostik und Neuropathologie). Ausgestattet werden ein Hörsaal, drei Kurssäle sowie mehrere Besprechungsräume mit moderner Medien-, Beschallungs- und Videokonferenztechnik, einschließlich einer AVoIP-basierten Signalverteilung und einer LED-Videowand. Der Auftrag umfasst die Werk- und Montageplanung, Lieferung, Installation und Inbetriebnahme der medientechnischen Anlagen inkl. Mediensteuerung, Dozententischanlagen und Displaystelen, sowie Einweisungen und Schulungen über die Systemkomponenten.

title: SSN(X) Concept Design Area of Interest
description: *11.24.2026 Update: Please see the list below of updates pertaining to this AOI Notice: Updated Question DoD SAFE Link Request: Deadline changed to 6:00 p.m. ET on November 25, 2026 Updated Phase I Submission: Deadline changed to 08:00 a.m. ET on December 07, 2026 Uploaded Government Responses to Q&A submission Director, Submarine Programs (DSP), via the New Attack Submarine (SSN(X)) Program Office (PMS 351), seeks industry solutions to advance the design of a novel SSN(X) System Arrangement Concept Design and reduce technical risk associated with its integration within a hydrostatically balanced Whole-Ship Submarine Concept Design (SCD). PMS 351 requires technically credible, producible, sustainable, and digitally traceable submarine concepts that integrate Government-furnished warfighting capability priorities, applicable specifications, standards, design theory, and criteria, and major shipboard systems. PMS 351 seeks innovative prototype approaches that apply advanced digital engineering, model-based engineering, and Super Intelligence (SI) to produce system-level and whole-ship design artifacts that inform decisions, reduce risk, and support PMS 351�s transition from concept design to preliminary design, including the approach to preliminary design product development, execution, and associated systems engineering planning. The Navy will be utilizing the Other Transaction Authority pathway outlined in Title 10 U.S.C � 4022. It is intended that this solicitation may result in the award of one or more prototype projects. There are 5 attachments to this AOI, some of which contain Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI): SSN(X) Terms of Use (TOU) Agreement (CUI) AOI Problem Statement AOI Guidance AOI Vendor Security Questionnaire SSN(X) AOI Questions Form Companies should proceed with the following steps to respond to this notice: STEP 1 Terms of Use (TOU) Agreement Several key documents related to the SSN(X) System Arrangement Concept Design and Whole-Ship SCD AOI are only releasable to eligible businesses with proper personnel and facility security clearances. The ability to be awarded an Agreement will depend upon the ability of the business to obtain and possess necessary clearances and approvals to obtain access to controlled information. Companies interested in submitting a technical solution in response to the AOI shall complete Attachment 1: TOU Agreement and return it via e-mail to the Agreements Officer, Agreements Specialist, and security point of contact listed in this notice. The Company point of contact that will request access to the controlled document in this notice shall be the Company point of contact listed in the TOU. IMPORTANT NOTICE: To maintain appropriate information security protocols, the problem statement for this Area of Interest (AOI) will not be distributed via open channels.Companies should request access to the CUI document in SAM at the time of TOU submittal to the Government. Once the signed TOU is received and verified, PMS 351 will grant access to the CUI document and transmit relevant UNCLASSIFIED Government-Furnished Information (GFI) to the Company point of contact listed in the TOU. The TOU provided as Attachment 1 is specific to this AOI release. STEP 2 Questions and Answers Opportunity Companies may submit questions using Attachment 5: SSN(X) AOI Questions Form. PMS 351 will only accept unclassified questions up to the CUI level. Questions shall be submitted electronically via DoD SAFE to the Government points of contact listed in this notice. Companies must request a DoD SAFE link by e-mailing ALL Government points contacts listed in this notice (with the email subject as SSN(X) Questions) no later than 6:00p.m. Eastern Time on November 25, 2026. Companies must submit questions via DoD SAFE no later than 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time on November 30, 2026. This opportunity is not to be construed as a commitment by the Government, nor will the Government reimburse respondents for any questions submitted or for the information provided in response to this notice. The Government may or may not respond to questions and reserves the right to redact and modify the content of submissions prior to any release back to industry. The Government may use the information and feedback from questions to inform future solicitations as necessary. Respondents are solely responsible for properly marking and clearly identifying any proprietary information or trade secrets contained in any submission in response to this notice. Opting not to submit any questions does not preclude participation in this AOI or any future engagements. It is the responsibility of industry to monitor the Government Point of Entry (GPE) for official AOI communications. STEP 3 Companies shall submit Phase I White Papers electronically via encrypted DoD SAFE transmission. Companies must request a DoD SAFE link by e-mailing ALL Government points contacts listed in this notice (with the email subject as SSN(X) White Paper) no later than 6:00p.m. Eastern Time on November 25, 2026. Companies are encouraged to submit White Papers prior to the closing date. Inclusion of a delivery receipt with an email submission will be the only indication of the Government�s successful receipt of a White Paper. Each Company must comply with DoD SAFE file size limitations and other guidance as provided at https://safe.apps.mil/. Phase I submissions must be received by the Government via encrypted DoD SAFE submission no later than 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time on December 07, 2026. description: Market Research � Domestic Manufacturing & Supply of Burial Casket Liners and Interior Fabrics ("Crepe, Satin, or Similar Material" per DA PAM 638�2) � Berry Amendment Compliance Primary NAICS Code: 339995 � Burial Casket Manufacturing Cross-Referenced Textile NAICS Codes: 313210 (Broadwoven Fabric Mills), 313310 (Textile and Fabric Finishing Mills), 314999 (All Other Miscellaneous Textile Product Mills) Product Service Codes (PSC): 9930 (Memorials, Cemeteries and Mortuary Equipment) & 8305 (Textile Fabrics) 1. DISCLAIMER: This Request for Information (RFI) / Sources Sought Notice is issued solely for information, market research, and planning purposes in accordance with FAR Part 10. It does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), Request for Quote (RFQ), or Invitation for Bid (IFB), nor is it a commitment by the U.S. Government to issue a solicitation or award a contract. The Government will not reimburse respondents for any costs associated with preparing or submitting information in response to this notice. 2. BACKGROUND & PURPOSE: The Mission and Installation Contracting Command (MICC) � Fort Knox, on behalf of the Department of the Army, Casualty and Mortuary Affairs Operations Division (CMAOD), is conducting market research to identify domestic manufacturers and suppliers capable of providing burial caskets and 100% domestically produced casket liners and interior upholstery fabrics compliant with the Berry Amendment (10 U.S.C. � 4862, formerly 10 U.S.C. � 2533a) and DFARS 252.225-7012. Under the Berry Amendment, textile components used in Department of Defense (DoD) caskets must be wholly grown, reprocessed, reused, extruded, spun, woven, finished, and sewn in the United States. Currently, the Army operates under a 10-year Class Domestic Non-Availability Determination (DNAD) (MICC DNAD DF 19-01) for casket liners that expires in November 2029. In coordination with interagency domestic-sourcing working groups and the U.S. AbilityOne Commission, the Army is evaluating the domestic industrial base to establish Berry Amendment-compliant casket liner sources prior to the waiver's expiration. 3. description: This requirement has been set aside under the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB) and is open only to eligible Indigenous businesses. title: English to Inuktitut Translation Services
description: Limited to firms on the Inuit Firm Registry (IFR). This solicitation of offer is limited to offerors registered on the Inuit Firm Registry (IFR). Background Pursuant to section 46 of the Nunavut Act, the Auditor General is required to annually audit accounts and financial statements of the Government of Nunavut. As part of this requirement, the Office of the Auditor General of Canada (the OAG) produces a variety of documents, including the annual Nunavut report, that need to be translated from English into Inuktitut, in either the North or South Baffin dialect. Translated documents will also need to be edited and updated. Objective The objective of this procurement process is for the Contractor to provide timely, consistent and reliable English to Inuktitut translation and editing services for Nunavut reports, opening statements and communication products that will be presented by the OAG to the government of Nunavut. The OAG will also require translation or editing of other types of documents varying in length and topic throughout the year, including consolidated financial statements. The Contractor will perform all work from its own facilities. No travel is anticipated for the duration of the resulting contract. In executing the work, Contractor managed devices, tools and IT services will only be used when processing unprotected information. The OAG will provide a laptop computer and access to the OAG network when the work requires access to protected information. title: Web-based Platform for Whole Building Life Cycle Analysis (WBLCA) and Embodied Carbon emissions in building and infrastructure construction
description: The National Research Council on behalf of the Government of Canada (GoC) and its’ Partners seek to procure a secure, scalable, bilingual web-based digital platform (“the platform”) to support the reporting, review, analysis, and visualization of embodied carbon emissions in building and infrastructure construction projects. This procurement includes the design, development, configuration, deployment and ongoing support of the platform. The solution will provide a centralized system that ensure consistent data collection, automated validation, and reporting in alignment with embodied carbon disclosure and reduction policies for buildings and infrastructure projects. At a minimum, the platform shall enable: - Intake of material and project specific embodied carbon submissions; - Import and export capabilities for compatible whole building Life Cycle Assessment (wbLCA) submission reports and raw data; - Dashboards and customizable reporting functions for internal analysis; and - The creation of an anonymized public dataset. The Platform MUST comply with Government of Canada security requirements for Protected A information and meet Canadian-based data residency requirements.

title: inversion of the electric field streaming otential-controlled source electromagnetic (spCSEM) data acquired at the Aquistore site
description: The objective of this work is to perform an inversion of the electric field spCSEM data acquired at the Aquistore site. An equivalent point-source SP inversion of the electrical related data should be performed to estimate a) fluid injection intensity (source strength), b) pore pressure gradient around the injection point, c) pressure propagation away from the injector, and d) changes in pressure-driven flow behavior through time. NRCan expects that the contractor uses the calculated pressure gradients to reconstruct plume boundaries (subject to additional information).

title: Oxygen regulator overhaul kits (ACAN)
description: 1. Advance Contract Award Notice (ACAN) An ACAN is a public notice indicating to the supplier community that a department or agency intends to award a contract for goods, to a pre-identified supplier, thereby allowing other suppliers to signal their interest in bidding, by submitting a statement of capabilities. If no supplier submits a statement of capabilities that meets the requirements set out in the ACAN, on or before the closing date stated in the ACAN, the contracting officer may then proceed with the award to the pre-identified supplier. 2. Definition of Requirement The Department of National Defence (DND) has a requirement for the supply of the following: • Item: Oxygen Regulator Overhaul Kit (Parts Kit, Elastom) • Part Number (PN): 909-010-073 • NATO Stock Number (NSN): 1660-00-385-2846 • NATO Commercial and Government Entity Code (NCAGE): 80477 (Adams Rite Aerospace, Inc.) • Quantity: 120 units The explicit purpose of these flight-safety kits is to execute a critical engineering program to refurbish and recondition the legacy onboard oxygen regulators across the CF188 Hornet fighter aircraft fleet in order to extend their operational service life. 3. Criteria for assessment of the Statement of Capabilities (Minimum Essential Requirements) Any interested supplier must demonstrate by way of a formal Statement of Capabilities that its product meets the following mandatory criteria: • Traceability and Configuration: The supplier must provide certified proof of a direct, unbroken supply chain traceability path to the original equipment manufacturer (OEM), Adams Rite Aerospace, Inc. (NCAGE: 80477), ensuring the component matches Part Number: 909-010-073. OR • Technical Data Equivalence: If an alternative, non-OEM kit is proposed, the supplier must provide a complete engineering data package—including precise chemical compound formulations, material tolerances, and dimensional blueprints—sufficient to undergo a full engineering review by DND’s Technical Airworthiness Authority (TAA) to verify compatibility with the legacy CF188 Hornet oxygen regulator architecture. • Regulatory Airworthiness Certification: The supplier must provide an official Certificate of Conformance or equivalent airworthiness release documentation that satisfies the requirements of the DND’s TAA for critical pilot life-support equipment. 4. This procurement is subject to the following trade agreement(s) • World Trade Organization Agreement on Government Procurement (WTO GPA) - Revised • Canada-Panama Free Trade Agreement • Canada-Korea Free Trade Agreement (CKFTA) • Canada-Honduras Free Trade Agreement • Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA) • Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) • Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP) • Canada-Ukraine Free Trade Agreement 2023 Modernized (CUFTA) • Canada-UK Trade Continuity Agreement (Canada-UK TCA) • Canada-Chile Free Trade Agreement (CCFTA) • Canada-Colombia Free Trade Agreement • Canada-Peru Free Trade Agreement (CPFTA) 5. Justification for the Pre-Identified Supplier The parts and service sought by the Department of National Defence (as outlined under part 2) are only available from Blue Aerospace LLC as authorized re-seller of the original equipment manufacturer and holder of intellectual property rights, Adams Rite Aerospace, Inc. 6. Government Contracts Regulations Exception The following exception to the Government Contracts Regulations is invoked for this procurement under subsection 6(d) - "only one person is capable of performing the work". 7. Exclusions and/or Limited Tendering Reasons The following exclusion(s) and/or limited tendering reasons are invoked under: Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA), Article 513.1: Limited Tendering (b) (ii) the protection of patents, copyrights, or other exclusive rights; Canada–Chile Free Trade Agreement (CCFTA), Article Kbis-09: Tendering Procedures, para 1 : Limited Tendering b. where the goods or services can be supplied only by a particular supplier and no reasonable alternative or substitute exists; Canada–Colombia Free Trade Agreement (CCoFTA), Article 1409 Limited Tendering b. ii. The protection of patents, copyrights or other exclusive rights; Canada–Honduras Free Trade Agreement (CHFTA), Chapter 17, Article 17.11 Limited Tendering (b) (ii) the good or service is protected by a patent, copyright or other exclusive intellectual property right; Canada–Korea Free Trade Agreement (CKFTA), which defers to WTO-AGP Article XV, Limited Tendering b) when, for works of art or for reasons connected with protection of exclusive rights, such as patents or copyrights; Canada–Panama Free Trade Agreement (CPFTA), Chapter 16, Article 16.10 Limited Tendering b. ii. a good or service being procured is protected by a patent, copyright or another exclusive right; Canada–Peru Free Trade Agreement (CPAFTA), Article 1409: Limited Tendering (b) (ii) the protection of patents, copyrights or other exclusive rights; World Trade Organization – Agreement on Government Procurement - Revised (WTO-AGP), Article XV – Limited Tendering b. Limited Tendering b) when, for works of art or for reasons connected with protection of exclusive rights, such as patents or copyrights, or in the absence of competition for technical reasons, the products or services can be supplied only by a particular supplier and no reasonable alternative or substitute exists; Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA), Article 19.12(b)(ii) the protection of patents, copyrights or other exclusive rights; Canada-United Kingdom Trade Continuity Agreement (Canada-UK TCA) - The provisions of CETA are incorporated by reference into and made part of this Agreement; Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP), Article 15.10 (b) (ii) the protection of patents, copyrights or other exclusive rights; Canada–Ukraine Free Trade Agreement - 2023 Modernized (CUFTA) -The provisions of WTO-AGP Article XV, Limited Tendering are incorporated by reference into and made part of this Agreement. 8. Ownership of Foreground Intellectual Property o Ownership of any Foreground Intellectual Property arising out of the proposed contract will vest in the Contractor. 9. Period of the proposed contract or delivery date o Delivery of the items is to begin by 01 March 2027. 10. Cost estimate of the proposed contract The estimated value of the contract is $8,894,096.20 CAD (taxes excluded). 11. Name and address of the pre-identified supplier: Blue Aerospace LLC., 6501B Nob Hill Road, Tamarac, FL 33321 United States. 12. Suppliers' right to submit a statement of capabilities Suppliers who consider themselves fully qualified and available to provide the goods, services or construction services described in the ACAN may submit a statement of capabilities in writing to the contact person identified in this notice on or before the closing date of this notice. The statement of capabilities must clearly demonstrate how the supplier meets the advertised requirements. 13. Closing date for a submission of a statement of capabilities The closing date and time for accepting statements of capabilities is 07 December 2026 at 14:00 EST. 14. description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky v tomto zadávacím řízení je: a) zpracování prvotního grafického návrhu periodika z podkladů předložených zadavatelem (redakční radou zpravodaje Jílovská sova) ve formátech WORD, EXCEL, PDF, JPG, aj. title: Karstulan koulukuljetusten hankintakonsultointi
description: Karstulan koulukuljetusten hankintakonsultointi Karstulan kunta valmistelee koulukuljetuspalvelujen kilpailuttamista kolmen vuoden sopimuskaudelle sekä kahdelle erilliselle optiovuodelle. Hankinnan kohteena on asiantuntijapalvelu, jossa valittava hankintakonsultti suunnittelee ja toteuttaa koulukuljetusten kilpailutuksen yhteistyössä Karstulan kunnan kanssa. Konsultin tulee huolehtia kilpailutusprosessin lainmukaisesta, tarkoituksenmukaisesta ja aikataulun mukaisesta toteuttamisesta. Tavoitteena on muodostaa koulukuljetuspalveluista toiminnallisesti selkeä ja kilpailukelpoinen hankintakokonaisuus, joka turvaa oppilaiden turvalliset ja toimivat kuljetukset, mahdollistaa keskenään vertailukelpoisten tarjousten antamisen, huomioi Karstulan kunnan alueelliset olosuhteet, edistää toimivien kuljetusmarkkinoiden muodostumista, sisältää selkeän ja hallittavan hinnoittelumallin, mahdollistaa sopimuksen tehokkaan seurannan sopimuskauden aikana sekä vähentää hankintamenettelyyn ja sopimuskauteen liittyviä oikeudellisia ja taloudellisia riskejä. Koulukuljetusten varsinaisen sopimuskauden suunniteltu alkamisajankohta on 1.8.2027. Sopimuskausi on kolme kouluvuotta sekä kaksi erillistä optiovuotta, päättyen näiden jälkeen 31.7.2032. Konsulttipalveluun tulee sisältyä seuraavat tehtäväkokonaisuudet: 1. koulukyytihankinnan ja sen osakokonaisuuksien suunnittelu 2. markkinakartoituksen ja tarvittaessa markkinavuoropuhelun suunnittelu ja toteuttaminen 3. tarjouspyynnön, palvelukuvauksen ja sopimusehtojen laatiminen 4. vertailuperusteiden, pisteytysmallin ja hinnoittelurakenteen muodostaminen 5. hankintailmoituksen ja tarjouspyynnön julkaiseminen HILMAssa 6. tarjoajien kysymyksiin annettavien vastausten valmistelu 7. tarjousten tarjouspyynnönmukaisuuden tarkastaminen 8. tarjousten vertailu ja vertailuasiakirjojen laatiminen 9. hankintapäätösesityksen valmistelu perusteluineen 10. hankintaoikaisujen, oikaisuvaatimusten ja muiden muutoksenhakutilanteiden käsittelyyn osallistuminen 11. sopimusasiakirjojen valmistelu ja sopimusten viimeistely. Koulukyytikilpailutuksessa laadittavan tarjouspyynnön tulee olla kirjallinen ja niin selkeä, että sen perusteella voidaan antaa keskenään vertailukelpoisia tarjouksia. Hankinnan kuvaus, soveltuvuusvaatimukset, vertailuperusteet, tarjousten määräaika ja voimassaolo ovat tarjouspyynnön keskeisiä tietoja.,

Työn yhteydessä syntyvät jätteet tulee lajitella voimassa olevien jätehuolto-ohjeiden mukaisesti. Henkilöstön saatavuus Toimittajan henkilöstön saatavuuden vasteaika on enintään kahdeksan (8) tuntia tilauksesta työpäivisin klo 7.00–17.00. Muina aikoina vasteaika on enintään 24 tuntia tilauksesta. Vasteaika koskee yhden työparin toimittamista tilaajan käyttöön. Tilaajalla on oikeus muuttaa työvoimatarvetta, työjakson aloitusajankohtaa sekä työjakson kestoa ilmoittamalla muutoksesta toimittajalle vähintään 24 tuntia etukäteen. Muutosten perusteena voivat olla esimerkiksi muutokset laitoksen käyttötilanteessa, työsuunnitelmissa tai työaikatauluissa. Toimittaja vastaa kaikista sellaisista välittömistä kustannuksista, jotka aiheutuvat toimittajan työkomennuksen aikana tekemistä henkilöstömuutoksista. Vastuut ja velvoitteet Toimittaja vastaa aiheuttamistaan vahingoista tilaajan koneille, laitteille, työvälineille sekä käyttöönsä saamilleen työkaluille voimassa olevan vahingonkorvauslainsäädännön ja sopimusehtojen mukaisesti. Toimittaja vastaa käyttämiensä aliurakoitsijoiden työstä, toiminnasta ja toimituksista kuten omastaan. Toimittaja vastaa siitä, että Turun Seudun Energiantuotanto Oy:n työturvallisuusohjeet, turvallisuuskäytännöt ja työmaakohtaiset määräykset saatetaan sen oman henkilöstön sekä mahdollisten aliurakoitsijoiden tietoon ja että niitä noudatetaan kaikessa työskentelyssä. Dokumentaatio ja raportointi Tilaaja luovuttaa toimittajan käyttöön työn suorittamisen kannalta tarvittavan dokumentaation. Toimittajan tulee palauttaa kaikki tilaajan luovuttamat asiakirjat ja aineistot tilaajan edustajalle työn valmistuttua, ellei toisin sovita. Toimittajan tulee raportoida kirjallisesti kaikki suoritetut toimenpiteet, tehdyt havainnot sekä työn aikana havaitut poikkeamat. Raportti on toimitettava tilaajan edustajalle viipymättä työn valmistumisen jälkeen. Tilaajan järjestämät resurssit Tilaaja luovuttaa toimittajan henkilöstön käyttöön veloituksetta työn suorittamisessa tarvittavat erikoistyökalut, työhön kuuluvat materiaalit sekä käytettävissä olevat sosiaalitilat. Tarjouspyynnön liitteissä on tarkempaa tietoa hankinnan sisällöstä. Tarjoajan tulee huomioida liiteaineisto tarjouksen valmistelussa. Pakollinen tutustuminen työskentely-ympäristöön Tarjoajan edellytetään osallistuvan hankintayksikön järjestämään voimalaitosalueen esittelyyn ennen tarjouksen jättämistä, jotta tarjoajalle selviää työskentely-ympäristö ja vallitsevat olosuhteet. title: Intrinsic Market Resilience (IMR)
description: The evolution of markets from physical trading floors to interconnected, electronic venues has introduced new speed, transparency, and efficiency, but has also created new attack surfaces and systemic risks. Modern markets, which host trading for everything from equities and bonds to energy and cloud computing resources, can be manipulated in ways unanticipated by their designers. The 2010 United States Equity market "flash crash" and the 2000-2001 California energy crisis demonstrated how weaknesses in a market's public interfaces could have dramatic consequences. Similar design issues in today's complex, interacting market systems could be used to cause economic damage, which the IMR program technology seeks to prevent. The IMR program aims to develop repair methods to protect essential economic sectors against devastating attacks that exploit the public interfaces of modern markets. Current legal and regulatory protections focus on deterring profit-seeking manipulation and ensuring compliance, but they do not sufficiently protect markets from adversaries aiming simply to cause disruption. The IMR program seeks to address this gap by developing the tools to automatically model market designs, identify hidden weaknesses, and recommend and analyze repairs on the market models to make markets fundamentally more resilient to attack. IMR aims to combine Large Language Model (LLM)-based automation with rigorous modeling and analysis to identify remediations for market weaknesses. The program will develop formal notations to precisely describe how markets operate and coordinate, creating machine-analyzable models from informal descriptions like regulatory filings and technical specifications. Against these models, IMR will formulate and assess "resilience conjectures� - mathematical statements about desirable market properties, such as the inability for actors to manipulate prices without risking loss. By automatically analyzing these conjectures, the program aims to prove that a market design is resilient in specific ways or, if it is not, to generate a counterexample that illustrates a concrete weakness. These counterexamples will then be used to refine the conjectures and, ultimately, to recommend and confirm specific repairs to the market's design. This approach is intended to provide a capability to protect U.S. markets against adversaries who wish to cause chaos, ensuring the stability of both civilian and military critical resources that rely on modern market mechanisms.

title: Intrinsic Market Resilience (IMR)
description: The evolution of markets from physical trading floors to interconnected, electronic venues has introduced new speed, transparency, and efficiency, but has also created new attack surfaces and systemic risks. Modern markets, which host trading for everything from equities and bonds to energy and cloud computing resources, can be manipulated in ways unanticipated by their designers. The 2010 United States Equity market "flash crash" and the 2000-2001 California energy crisis demonstrated how weaknesses in a market's public interfaces could have dramatic consequences. Similar design issues in today's complex, interacting market systems could be used to cause economic damage, which the IMR program technology seeks to prevent. The IMR program aims to develop repair methods to protect essential economic sectors against devastating attacks that exploit the public interfaces of modern markets. Current legal and regulatory protections focus on deterring profit-seeking manipulation and ensuring compliance, but they do not sufficiently protect markets from adversaries aiming simply to cause disruption. The IMR program seeks to address this gap by developing the tools to automatically model market designs, identify hidden weaknesses, and recommend and analyze repairs on the market models to make markets fundamentally more resilient to attack. IMR aims to combine Large Language Model (LLM)-based automation with rigorous modeling and analysis to identify remediations for market weaknesses. The program will develop formal notations to precisely describe how markets operate and coordinate, creating machine-analyzable models from informal descriptions like regulatory filings and technical specifications. Against these models, IMR will formulate and assess "resilience conjectures� - mathematical statements about desirable market properties, such as the inability for actors to manipulate prices without risking loss. By automatically analyzing these conjectures, the program aims to prove that a market design is resilient in specific ways or, if it is not, to generate a counterexample that illustrates a concrete weakness. These counterexamples will then be used to refine the conjectures and, ultimately, to recommend and confirm specific repairs to the market's design. This approach is intended to provide a capability to protect U.S. markets against adversaries who wish to cause chaos, ensuring the stability of both civilian and military critical resources that rely on modern market mechanisms.
